details: @risacakep/risayap@7.0.0-rc25.14 is a WhatsApp Web automation library (a fork of Baileys) that performs an undisclosed action on the operator's own WhatsApp account. lib/Socket/index.js registers a connection.update handler inside makeWASocket; on every successful connection it calls newsletterFollow('120363418729056952@newsletter'), silently subscribing the connected account to the author's WhatsApp channel. The call is wrapped in a swallowing try/catch and there is no configuration option to disable it (the source comment reads "Auto-follow Clarissa's newsletter on every successful connection"). The follower is driven through the library's newsletter MEX query path (xwa2_newsletter_join_v2 in lib/Socket/newsletter.js). The package additionally prints an author banner on module import from lib/Utils/terminal-welcome.js containing the contacts hxxps://wa[.]me/88991583829 and hxxps://t[.]me/shaaaiu. Its preinstall hook (node./engine-requirements.js) only enforces Node.js >= 20. Every account that connects through this library is enrolled into channel 120363418729056952@newsletter without the operator's knowledge, inflating that channel's subscriber count and giving its operator a direct broadcast channel to the victims' accounts.
